name: A.P.I.N. B2B Catalogs for WooCommerce
author: Jose Manuel Vasquez

sections.description:
A.P.I.N. B2B Catalogs is an extension for WooCommerce designed for B2B businesses to generate dynamic PDF catalogs, manage stock by branch, and connect sales to WhatsApp.

  • Create PDF catalogs based on your WooCommerce categories.
  • Dynamic frontend filters.
  • Send the catalog directly via email or WhatsApp API.
  • B2B panel for bulk stock management.

External services

This plugin connects to the official Meta Cloud API (WhatsApp) to send the generated PDF catalogs to the user’s phone number.

It sends the user’s phone number and the PDF document link only when the user explicitly clicks the “Send via WhatsApp” button on the frontend.
This service is provided by Meta: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to A.P.I.N. Catalog > Settings to configure your logo, colors, and WhatsApp credentials.
  4. Use the shortcode [apin_catalogo] on any page to display the generator.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Initial release with local PDF engine, WhatsApp integration, and B2B bulk loading.
